Question B-001-022-003.

Why the correct answer is right: An accredited examiner may charge enough to recover the cost of administering an examination.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "$20 per qualification": Accredited examiners may recover administration costs rather than charging a fixed per-qualification amount.
- sourceIndex 2: "No fee may be charged": Accredited examiners may recover administration costs, so a no-fee rule is too absolute.
- sourceIndex 3: "$20 per examination sitting": This invents a fixed sitting charge instead of cost recovery.
